newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent spot diesel fuel prices ease.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent spot diesel fuel prices ease.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot diesel fuel prices eased modestly on Thursday, tracking weakness in Gulf Coast prices that rippled through the spot and futures markets, traders said.

Forecasts of warmer temperatures and the start of a new crude unit for processing heavy sour crude at Lyondell-Citgo's 235,000 barrel per day Houston refinery cooled heating oil prices in morning trade.
Group Three low sulphur diesel for prompt deliveries was heard done 4.70 cents a gallon over NYMEX March heating oil, with high sulphur 2.50/2.75 cents over the print.
Chicago low sulphur was talked 4.0/4.25 cents a gallon over front-month heating oil futures, with high sulphur 1.75/2.0 cents over the print.
Unleaded for prompt deliveries was bid 2.50 cents over NYMEX March unleaded in Group Three and 0.50 cent under the print in Chicago.
